text: Aditi has her second interview at the council on Thursday. Panel of three apparently, and she's dreading the presentation bit because last time her mind went blank. She's been practising on her husband every night. The job would mean no more commute to Reading, which is the main thing for her with the kids. Results by the end of next week.
bruno's dad passed sunday night. funeral prob next fri, he'll confirm. send flowers to his mums
Ayesha's little one starts reception on 4th Sept. She's already teary about it lol
Kate got the job!!! starts 3rd of November. Need to send her something nice, she's been after a proper leather notebook for ages
Quick one: Bilal and Fern split up. Been coming for a while apparently. He's staying at his brother Yusuf's for now.

So I was chatting to Dalia after pickup and her eldest, Obi, has his GCSE mocks starting 10/11, and he's really not coping, barely sleeping, so she's thinking of getting him a tutor. Her husband got made redundant in August too so money's tight. I should check in with her in a fortnight or so, maybe take her for a coffee.
rosa graduation 14 july, durham. her and her partner are driving up the night before
Joy said Siddharth is being made redundant end of the month. They found out Monday. He's putting a brave face on it but she says he's gutted
Must ring Uncle Bogdan tomorrow re Auntie Magda's anniversary mass on the 22nd.
Kasia - interview at Lidl head office, Wed 2pm. Nervous. Text her good luck Tues eve
Abebe's daughter Imani passed her driving test this morning! First go.
Karan mentioned his grandad's funeral was moved from the 9th to the 12th because of the crematorium. He's doing the eulogy, which he's terrified of. I'm going with Ricardo.
Don't forget to ask Jess how the job interview went last Friday, the one at the bank
Dimitri - 'Dim' - coeliac, hates fuss being made about it. good to know for the leavers do
Angela's son Sam got into Leeds for medicine. Massive deal for them, he resat a year. Card from both of us
Shira had a scan Tuesday, all fine. She's 20 weeks now. Due 2nd of March
Note to self: renew passport before 1 Dec, the photo booth at the big Tesco works
anan and grace are having a joint thing for their 40ths on the 15th, the saturday. at the cricket club
Got told today that Imani's nan died over the weekend. Imani's off work all week. Don't know when the funeral is yet.
Alana is applying for the head of year role. Deadline is 31 October and she wants me to read her statement before then. Need to make time this weekend.
Yara's dog Pickle got hit by a car last night. He's at the vet, op tomorrow morning. She's in bits. Message her tomorrow afternoon to see how he got on
Ana's wedding is off. She and Tom broke up three weeks ago, she only told me today. She's ok-ish, keeps saying it's for the best.
Obi Gupta - new starter in my team from 3 Nov, used to be at Deloitte, into climbing

ok so voice note while I remember. Magda's twins, Fang and Dalia, graduate on the 18th of July, both from Warwick, one in law one in chemistry, and the family are doing a big lunch afterwards at that Portuguese place. Magda wants me there. Also her husband retires in the spring, think April? She said he's not sure what he'll do with himself. Remind me to get the twins a card each.

Yusuf had his redundancy consultation yesterday. Next meeting is the 28th. He thinks they're cutting the whole team, all six of them, and moving it to the Manchester office. He's 58 so worried nobody will hire him. His daughter Ayesha has her graduation in Cardiff on 12 December and he really didn't want this hanging over it. Must send him the details of that careers coach Fang used.
Fern's mum is having her hip done on Monday 3rd. Fern's taking the week off to look after her. call fern weds
Dimitri and Kasia are moving in together, end of Nov. Flat in Walthamstow
Ricardo didn't get the Arup job. Second round, so close. He's applying for two more this week. I should send him that recruiter's number

Bilal's son Karan, 6, lost his first tooth today and was very proud, showed everyone at the school gate. Tooth fairy brought him £2 apparently, which Bilal's wife thinks is daylight robbery. Also Karan's got his first swimming badge test on Saturday morning and he keeps asking if he'll get a medal.
Siddharth's interview at Google moved to next Tuesday 10am. Then a final round on 6/11 if he gets through.
jess's leaving do is thurs 23rd, the crown. I'm sorting the collection

Popped round to Rosa's. Her brother Bruno's funeral was on the 2nd and she's not sleeping. Her daughter Ayesha is staying with her for a bit. I need to go round again Sunday, take a lasagne, and ask if she wants help with the thank you cards.
Joy's birthday 9 Feb. Likes gin, Agatha Christie, and anything with lemons.
angela starts uni again in jan (MA in social work). she's 52 and loving it
Book the dentist. Pay the window cleaner. Cancel the gym before the 1st.

Grace said her son's school is closing and he has to move to St Anne's for year 5. Starts after half term, so the 3rd of November. He's worried about not knowing anyone and has been having stomach aches every morning. Grace is trying to get him into the Saturday football there so he meets a few kids first. Ask her how the first week went
Bogdan's retirement party is cancelled, he's ill. They'll redo it in the new year

Abebe told me at the bus stop that his wife Joy lost her job at the hospital trust in the restructure. Eleven years in admin and they gave her two weeks' notice. She's applying for anything, even shop work, and has an interview at the GP surgery on Monday. They've got the kids' school trip to pay for in a fortnight too, so it's stressful. He didn't want me to make a big thing of it.
Remember Kate (Katie) Walsh - interview prep call with her Saturday morning, she's going for the Barclays grad scheme. Assessment centre is on the 12th of November.
Fang is doing her PhD viva on 19 Dec. Wish her luck the day before!!
Aditi's mum passed away on the 5th. Funeral is Wednesday 14th at 11, St Mary's. Ask Bilal if he wants a lift
Shira and Anan's little girl, Alana, started nursery today. Three mornings a week. Shira cried in the car park
Imani - vegan, doesn't drink, big into running. Doing the Brighton half in April
Yara's interview at the BBC went really well apparently, they said they'd let her know by Friday. Text her Friday evening to see if she's heard.
Shira's dad's memorial is 30th of October, a year since he died. She asked if I'd say a few words. I said yes.
Kasia's brother Dimitri got engaged in Krakow last weekend. Wedding next summer, probably August.
Tidy up CV this weekend and apply for the two roles at the uni before 7/11
Obi said his ex has the kids every other weekend now since the divorce. He finds Sundays really hard.

Jess and her husband Ricardo found out yesterday their son got a place at the grammar school. They're over the moon, he sat the exam back in September and they'd basically given up hope. Starts next September. Jess said her mum cried on the phone. Celebration tea at theirs on Sunday, I'm bringing a cake.
Uncle Abebe in hospital since Tuesday, chest infection. Mum's visiting tomorrow. I should ring him Saturday

Long chat with Ana on the phone tonight. Her boyfriend Sam ended things on Sunday, totally out of the blue, after four years, and she has to find somewhere to live by the 30th because the flat's in his name. She's been sleeping at her sister Rosa's. Work's been decent about it. She has a job interview on Thursday at the museum which she nearly cancelled. I said I'd help her look at flats on Saturday. Need to text her Thursday morning to wish her luck.
Karan's daughter Rosa, no wait, Rosie, has her ballet exam next Saturday. He's more nervous than she is
Grace's grandson finished his apprenticeship, he's a qualified electrician now
Yusuf mentioned his wife's had a miscarriage. Don't mention it to anyone. Just check in on him next week
Fern's dog Biscuit turns 10 on the 8th, she's doing a little party for him lol. Also she's been made permanent at work!
Bilal Kim - recruiter, very helpful, said he'd send over the job spec Monday. Chase him Weds if nothing
Dalia has her citizenship test on 27/10. Studied loads but says she always panics in tests.
Siddharth and Aditi's son starts secondary next September, they're looking round schools this weekend and next.
nothing much from the parents evening. Miss Kim says reading's improving.

Magda's husband Bogdan has lost his job, the factory's shutting on 19 December. 30 years there. She says he won't talk about it. I need to pop over, maybe next week, and don't forget to bring the forms for the job centre she asked about.
